So crimes: fraud (诈骗) – specifically contract fraud? No contract, just deception for money: fraud (诈骗罪). Also illegal acquisition of personal information: illegal acquisition of personal data, which under Chinese law is "非法获取公民个人信息罪" (illegal acquisition of personal information). The examples: For similar case, they used "非法获取国家秘密" for state secrets. For personal info, typical charge is "非法获取公民个人信息罪". In Chinese criminal law, article 285? Actually article 285 of Criminal Law: "非法获取、出售或者提供公民个人信息罪". So the charge is "非法获取公民个人信息罪". In examples, they sometimes phrase as "非法获取国家秘密". For personal info, they might phrase as "非法获取公民个人信息". So answer should be two crimes: 诈骗;非法获取公民个人信息.
